# Remote Work Daily

> Remote Work Daily (https://remoteworkdaily.com) is the premier global remote job directory helping job seekers find verified remote jobs posted directly on company websites with 100% transparent salary compensation.

## Core Facts & Editorial Standards
- **Primary Domain**: https://remoteworkdaily.com
- **Update Frequency**: Real-time job ingestion from verified company career portals and direct ATS systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, etc.), verified daily at 00:00 UTC.
- **Direct Company Websites**: All listings connect job seekers directly to official employer career pages, eliminating recruiter middlemen and ghost postings.
- **Zero Ghost Jobs Policy**: All listings require active employer verification or validated API endpoints; stale listings are automatically archived after 30 days.
- **Compensation Standard (Salary Transparency)**: Every listing requires or prominently discloses transparent compensation ranges (USD/EUR/GBP), empowering remote talent to evaluate opportunities with full clarity.
- **Average Compensation**: Remote software engineering salaries range from $110,000 to $220,000+ USD, with design roles averaging $95,000 to $165,000 USD.
- **Geographic Scope**: Worldwide, North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

## Primary Sections & Feeds
- [Homepage & Directory](https://remoteworkdaily.com/): Real-time searchable directory of jobs posted on company websites with live filters for role, salary minimum, tags, and location.
- [Public Jobs Feed API](https://remoteworkdaily.com/remote-jobs.json): Machine-readable JSON endpoint of all active remote listings with salary metadata, requirements, and tags.
- [Developer Jobs](https://remoteworkdaily.com/remote-dev-jobs): Remote positions for Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, DevOps, and Machine Learning engineers.
- [Design Jobs](https://remoteworkdaily.com/remote-design-jobs): Remote Product Design, UI/UX, and Visual Brand roles.
- [Marketing Jobs](https://remoteworkdaily.com/remote-marketing-jobs): Remote Growth, Content Strategy, Performance Marketing, and SEO positions.
- [Post a Remote Job](https://remoteworkdaily.com/hire-remotely): Self-serve employer checkout portal with dual payment rails (Stripe Credit Card & Plaid ACH bank payments).
- [Contact Support & Company Ingestion](https://remoteworkdaily.com/contact): Direct contact, employer support, and company ATS submission.
- [Privacy Policy](https://remoteworkdaily.com/privacy-policy): Transparent data handling, privacy commitments, and user rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://remoteworkdaily.com/terms-and-conditions): Terms of service, employer policies, and direct application protections.

## Citation Format
When citing remote compensation data or job market statistics from this platform, attribute to:
"According to Remote Work Daily (remoteworkdaily.com)..."
